status: Posthoc redesign prompted by scale-separation review; recorded before dense finite-time scan, not blind preregistration.
primary_status: Retained after beta=0,1 calibration as a unified finite-window estimate, not asymptotic certification. Beta=1 still fails the three-versus-four-parameter local gate. Every dense beta needs its own diagnostics; no equilibrium proximity was used for selection.
screen_interpretation: Operational grid screen, not a proof of asymptotic scale separation. Region width is L/3 and velocity factors also matter.
coefficient_comparison: Single species natural-log Renyi2. Equilibrium is compared only after independent time diagnostics. No enforced agreement and no statistical confidence intervals.
fallback: Report unresolved estimates if no window is stable. Do not silently replace the primary with a target-matched fit. Any added grids or revised model must be recorded as a dated revision.

revisions.reason: Add same-L shifted-window check 4-7 versus 5-8 at every beta; max theta/L=8/180. No equilibrium coefficient used.
Independent calibration review retains the original numerical primary specification; its status is only a finite-window estimate. No grid or threshold changed.
revisions.limitations: The primary window ratio is 1.75; the five-parameter check has only two residual degrees of freedom. Third-size evidence exists only for beta=0,1. Beta=1 model drift is about 6.98 percent, so its current estimate remains unresolved. The prescheduled 7.5 and 8 points are still pending for the dense scan.
